sentences.text: If you blow up a tiny balloon inside a clogged artery, you have angioplasty.
But when the balloon goes down, the plaque springs back and the blood stops.
So you wrap the balloon in a metal mesh that holds the artery open.
But now scar tissue grows through the mesh and blocks it again.
So you coat the mesh with a drug that keeps the scar from growing back.
Now blood flows freely through the open mesh to the heart muscle.
The first stent went into a human heart artery in 1986, in Toulouse, France.
Add a thin wire and a tube that carry it in from the wrist or groin.
Congratulations, you have built a stent.
